title: Australians light candles for critically injured Helen Haines
paragraphs: Australians have lit candles to show their support for independent MP Helen Haines, four days after she was struck by a car outside her electorate office in Victoria's north-east.
The movement, which was shared widely on social media, invited people to light a candle at 8pm AEDT as a gesture of community peace and solidarity.
"At times like these, what unites us matters far more than what divides us," the Rural City of Wangaratta said in a statement earlier today.
